H — controls
Walk W A S D (Shift = faster) · Look mouse
Zoom mouse wheel (zooms far in) · E resets zoom
Rotary switches: left click = turn left (CCW), right click = turn right (CW). Spring-return switches return when released.
Pushbuttons: click (hold for TEST / raise-lower).
M/A stations: MAN / AUTO buttons; hold ▲ ▼ to move output (manual) or setpoint (auto, where adjustable).
Rod motion lever: hold left = IN, hold right = OUT.
Thumbwheels / setpoint readouts: left click raises, right click lowers (hold to run).
Plant computer CRT: click to page.
Annunciators: ACK silences the horn and stops flashing; RESET clears ringback. M = acknowledge + reset every box in the room.
Electrical (1-M-1, far left): one-line mimic breakers are TRIP / CLOSE spring switches; closing onto a live board needs the SYNC SEL switch on that breaker and the synchroscope near 12 o'clock.
ESF / RHR (1-M-6): RHR suction from loop 4 (FCV-74-1/-2, open below 380 psig), HX outlet / bypass flow stations, containment spray, Phase B reset, RVLIS on 1-M-5.
Feedwater heaters / turbine cycle (1-M-3): heater outlet temperatures, HP exhaust and MSR outlet, No.3 heater drain tank level and its pumps.
Instructor station: press Z anywhere (or click a monitor in the glass booth, back-left corner) to open / close the console: run / freeze, 1–8× speed, reset to an initial condition, snapshots, and malfunctions (LOCA, SGTR, steam line breaks, loss of offsite power, ATWS, stuck / dropped rods, valve, pump, breaker and instrument failures) with optional delay. Use + ADD TO SCENARIO to build a group (e.g. loss of offsite power + large LOCA) and TRIGGER SCENARIO to fire them on the exact same simulation step.
Back panels: component cooling, ERCW, containment cooling and control air are on 0-M-27A/B, continuing the right-hand wall of controls just past the end of 1-M-6. Radiation monitoring is on 0-M-12 at the end of that row: each RM channel has CHK SRC (hold) and RESET buttons; the purge exhaust monitors (RE-90-130/-131) actuate containment vent isolation on HIGH. The 0-M-27A section now carries the full control air system: lead / lag compressor selection, air dryer, non-essential header isolation and every header pressure.
Left-hand back row (past the open end of 1-M-1): 0-M-26 vital instrument power / 125 V DC / 480 V - a one-line of each vital channel (charger, battery breaker, inverter input / output breakers, INV / ALT transfer switch), spare charger alignment, 480 V board supply breakers and the 250 V DC turbine building battery. 1-M-15 containment isolation valves - a handswitch for every isolation valve and damper that has none elsewhere (open them one by one after the isolation signal is reset), ABI / CRI manual actuation and reset. Excess letdown is on the 1-M-6 desk next to boric acid.
Startup manual: press G to open / close the interactive startup manual (top right). The control for the current step is highlighted on the boards; F walks you to it, N skips a step, T changes the time speed (1x - 16x). Steps turn green when the plant shows they are done.
Multiplayer: P opens the session panel (code to share, operator list, leave / end); Enter opens chat. Other operators appear in the room in their colour, with a beam to the control they are aiming at.
VR: open the simulator from an https address in the headset's browser (Quest / Pico) or in Chrome / Edge with SteamVR running, start an initial condition, then press ENTER VR. Trigger operates what the laser points at (left / right half of a switch turns it that way), grip holds a magnifier, left stick walks, right stick snap-turns, A / X acknowledges + resets all annunciators, B / Y shows the controls card. Pointing at a meter or annunciator window shows its reading. Join multiplayer before entering VR to keep the instructor console on a PC.
Esc releases the mouse. If mouse capture is unavailable, the cursor aims instead: drag empty space (or arrow keys) to turn.
Click to return to the control room
